name: Gunite Pools of Nassau
primary_cta: Send my request (two-door quote builder: build or renovate / service my pool)
brand_truth: A third-generation Bahamian family firm, since 1972, that builds high-end residential and large commercial gunite pools and services them with monthly reports and GPS-tracked visits.
buyer: Homeowners and second-home owners in New Providence and Great Exuma, often away; architects, developers and hotel managers looking for a pool contractor.

direction.why: Dealt by direction.mjs; per GUIDE.md the design follows design.md: a pool builder's drawing table (plan sheet with live dimensions and water) beside their own finished pool, then a 3D anatomy of a gunite pool. Instrument Sans + Newsreader, limestone ground, pool-water accent.

current_site_findings: Every page ends in the same generic contact form; enquiries arrive without pool type, size, island or stage.
GPS-tracked visits and the monthly report are a short paragraph on an inner page.
1972 and the family story are hidden on About; the homepage has no year and no phone.
The Store tile opens a Google Maps search; stock photos and file names are mixed into their work.
Three different names across title, company and domain.
pitch_line: Your customers draw the pool they want on your first screen, and your first call starts with the size, shape, island and stage already in hand.
assumptions: No email or WhatsApp was found: the request is composed and copied, with Call (242) 397 1050; the live site would post to the office inbox (address to confirm).
Store hours not published: shown as 'Hours on request'.
Build door offers New Providence, Paradise Island, Great Exuma and Another island; confirm whether construction (not only service) is taken in Great Exuma.
Gallon and area figures are computed planning estimates (average 5 ft depth), labelled as rough.
The monthly report sheet is a labelled sample layout, not a real report; confirm the fields they report.
Photo captions do not name projects or islands; confirm which portfolio projects may be named.
notes: Built Nov 22 from the approved job spec and design.md. Deviations: no yard photo of theirs exists, so the outline is drawn on a plan sheet and over the visitor's own yard photo if added; the construction sequence is a procedural 3D section (R3F, lazy, paused off-screen, still in reduced motion) because their site has no labelled construction photos. No Lovable images used. Repo main was diverged locally; worked on a branch from origin/main renamed to main.
